description: Saves a designed campaign email under a name, as the email builder's Save email does, so any Email step can start from it; sending nothing. The saved email's id IS your idempotency_key: pass a new UUID (hyphens are fine) as idempotency_key, and reuse it when retrying so a repeat updates the same email instead of making a second. blocks is the email's content blocks (the same shape the builder saves); read campaigns' saved_emails to copy an existing one.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: save_campaign_email
title: Save a designed campaign email
